# Basirah review instructions

Use English for documentation and review comments. Preserve Arabic Islamic terms, quotations and UI text. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.

Focus on evidence provenance, reference correctness, stale-revision prevention, source approval, user-session ownership, injection resistance and explicit abstention. A schema-valid response is not necessarily religiously correct. Never approve new scholarly claims without attributed approved evidence.

Review tests for negative and outage paths. Never equate an API failure with false content. Do not mix incompatible embedding spaces or silently substitute different source editions. Do not expand the MVP into personal fatwas or unrestricted chat.

Flag credentials, personal user text, unlicensed corpora, raw provider HTML and unbounded model/provider calls. Check that documentation distinguishes planned from implemented behavior. Automated review supplements, but does not replace, human acceptance.
